rationale: ReadValue and token traversal have different refusal checkpoints for a comma before object end. Shared parser retains both owned diagnostics and the exact active container start. Only the actual structural consumer selects that token checkpoint; skipped/wrong-kind/raw/method values retain the whole-value checkpoint. Earlier semantic/child refusals are unchanged.
source_basis: Pinned SDK jsontext checkDelim restarts at previous value end plus leading whitespace; needDelim for an object end rejects the consumed comma. The whole-value scanner instead reaches the closing brace. Existing independent902 output directly captures both outcomes.
scope_limit: Only this observed object-end delimiter alternative is introduced; additional scalar/Unicode/array delimiter corners beyond902 remain separate full-surface work.
